$comment: Reviewed coverage waivers (plan WS-C C-5). The coverage-diff gate (npm run gen:coverage-matrix:check) fails when an advertised capability cell (engine × mechanism × operation × parameter set × sign variant) has no registered test and no waiver here.
Cells are exact "operation|parameterSet|variant" strings (no wildcards), so a NEW mechanism, operation, parameter set or variant is never silently covered by an old waiver.

Every waiver needs reason, owner and an ISO date. status "baseline-pending-review" = recorded at the WS-C baseline so the gate can detect new gaps; it is NOT an approval and must be reviewed (plan J-5). Only status "approved" means a reviewer accepted the gap.
Regenerate the baseline (for review, never blindly): npx tsx scripts/generate-coverage-matrix.ts --print-baseline-waivers --date YYYY-MM-DD

waivers.reason: Advertised and without any registered test. The 10 fixed-hash mechanisms this bare mechanism generalises are now covered by NIST ACVP vectors for all 120 (mechanism x parameter set) pairs (src/data/acvp/slhdsa_prehash_siggen_{sha2,shake}_test.json, registry 09e.prehash-siggen), but CKM_HASH_SLH_DSA itself is the caller-supplied-digest form: PKCS#11 v3.2 section 6.69.6 drives it through CK_HASH_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, which carries the hash mechanism alongside hedgeVariant and context. The harness builds only CK_SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT, and no vendored header in this repo defines the larger struct's field order, so a test for it would have to guess the memory layout. Left waived deliberately rather than covered by guesswork; closing it needs the struct layout confirmed against the engines first. Tracked in the open-gaps register.
